title: Grease Bottle
summary: Throw a bottle to create a 10 ft radius of flammable difficult terrain. Creatures can fall Prone.

fields.Throw: Action. Throw one bottle up to 60 ft. Creates a 10 ft radius Grease surface, reported to persist until removed or transformed.
fields.Grease: Difficult terrain halves movement speed. DC 12 Dexterity or fall Prone for 1 turn.
fields.Ignition: Fire transforms the surface into Fire. The pinned item notes that the apparent explosion in the combat log does not deal a separate explosive attack.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
